doc.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012

title: Goodman remembers him twelve years later and hires him
summary: Backstage in Toronto Goodman recognised him and soon phoned him about a Hackensack concert, beginning an eight year association.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: the critic for the Global Mail, a music critic, which is one of our big papers up there. And he played clarinet. So at the end of the concert he said, “Do you know Goodman?” I said, No I don’t know him, he’d never remember me,” I said, “He came to see me one night twelve years ago.” He said, “Well let’s go backstage and see if we can get a few words from him.” I said, “Okay.” So we go back and the dressing room door is open. And here’s Benny sitting with a bottle of a Mickey, a black and white whiskey, a Scotch whiskey, having a little taste. So he stops and he looks at me and he says “Peter, how are you?” Twelve years later. I said, “Fine, Benny.” He said, “What are you doing up here?” I said, “Well I live here and I’ve got a group in the theater, the hotel, and I’m doing concerts and I’m quite involved in studio work.” I said, “What are you doing Benny?” He said, “Oh, the odd bar mitzvah.” Then he said, “Naa, we’re going in the Rainbow Room in October.” I said, “Are you using vibes?” He said, “Why, would you like to come?” I said, “I’ll come for union scale for you.” He said, “Perfect.” So about two weeks later the phone rings and it’s Goodman. It was eight o’clock in the morning. I was just going off to do a television show with a country & western group, you know, a little percussionist. “Hello Peter, this is Benny. Benny Goodman.” I said, “Oh Benny, how are you.” He said, “Fine, we’ve got a concert in Hackensack with Bucky Pizzarelli, Milt Hinton, Bobby Rosengarden, Zoot Sims and Hank Jones and myself. Can you come?” I said, “When is it?” He says so-and-so. I said, “Yeah I can do it.” That was the beginning of an eight year association.
You drove from, was it Toronto you were in?
He was the most encouraging and generous, to me, person that I’ve ever played for. Dick’s very close. We have a different —
